title: [CON2-18] Appendix C has a stale default and is missing the new numeric rules
description: Review finding CON2-18: Appendix C has a stale default and is missing the new numeric rules (lens CON2). Location: spec/99-appendices.md:82. Fix: "lesser of `expiryHint` and the retention window (default 30 days)" conflicts with §10.4.3 (10:580) and §10.4.6 (10:636), which use the agreement's `retentionDays` and give no default. Change to "lesser of `expiryHint` and the agreement's `retentionDays`" and add the missing rows listed by the reviewer (5 s canonical-Commit window, 60 s previous sealing key, hourly admission key fetch, 7-day undecidable Welcome hold, 30 s SFU challenge freshness, 32/1000 generation window). Full text: notes/review2/CON2-verified.md and notes/review2/CON2.md.
